thread.text: Got it. A few details before I build it: 1) Which key uses the selected item? I suggest F (1-5 still select). 2) Sword: swing animation only (no enemies, since there is no combat for now), or should it also do something, like cutting tall grass? 3) Apple: an eating animation that uses up one apple, with a small heart and a message? There is no health bar yet. 4) Remove the potion and gem from the game for now? 5) Show the equipped item in the hand while walking in all 4 directions? 6) The real game is the BITS campus: should this become a general use-item system for campus items later (e.g. keycard, phone), with the sword and apple only on the test map?
